thread:
patricia: Hi all  second day. Quick Notion question: where are the official templates for onboarding notes, 1:1s, and runbooks? I can view them but can't Duplicate.
devex-bot: Quick checks: 1) Confirm you're in the Redwood workspace 2) Is the page a DB template or locked? 3) Are you 'Can view' only? If so request edit.
patricia: I'm in the right workspace. On desktop the page shows but Duplicate is greyed out and I don't see an owner field on the page.
jin: Welcome! Two common reasons: it's a database template (use the DB -> New -> pick template flow) or the master copy is locked/view-only. Which template are you trying to copy?
patricia: Runbook for incidents and the "1:1 + goals" starter.
people-ops: Hey Patricia  we maintain the 1:1 starter under People Ops > Templates and runbook templates under Company Home > Eng > Runbooks (it's a database). For the runbook, create a new row in the Runbooks DB and pick the Incident template. For the 1:1, ping us and we'll fix the perms.
patricia: Nice, that explains the runbook. I requested access for the 1:1 but it said "Request sent" and nothing changed.
aaron: If you requested access and it didn't update, sometimes the invite dialog doesn't grant edit rights automatically. @people-ops — could you check Patricia's perms?
people-ops: Gave Patricia 'Can edit' on People Ops > Templates > 1:1 starter. Try refreshing.
patricia: Refresh done, Duplicate is available now. Thank you! Quick follow-ups: 1) Where should I move duplicated runbooks so oncall can find them? 2) How do we annotate doc ownership?
jin: Operational runbooks should live in the shared eng-runbooks space (Company Home > Eng > eng-runbooks) and be tagged with the Owner property so oncall can query. Personal 1:1 notes belong in My Workspace or People Ops > Personal > 1:1s and shared with your manager.
claire: On ownership: top-level managed pages usually have an "Owner" property near the title. For team docs, add a small doc-meta block at the top with: Owner, Last updated, Contact. That really helps during incidents.
patricia: Good tip. Also, I tried on mobile earlier and the three-dot menu wasn't visible which was confusing.
aaron: Mobile hides a few controls; use desktop for duplication or to check Page history. Also watch out for template buttons vs DB templates  they behave differently.
people-ops: If you ever can't find the owner, ping #devex with the page link. We keep a small registry of critical runbooks and can assign backups.
patricia: Perfect. I'll duplicate the 1:1 into My Workspace and create a runbook entry in the Runbooks DB, then add doc-meta and owner. Will share links for a quick permissions check.
jin: Welcome aboard Patricia! If anything else pops up with Notion quirks, drop the link here.
patricia: Thanks everyone 44b
